sites.why: Rule 8: streaming responses.create with store=False on OpenAI(base_url=override or openai.base_url); base_url comes from OPENAI_BASE_URL / gpt.yml openai_base_url and defaults to api.openai.com; key from OPENAI_API_KEY or config (incl. per-assistant openai_api_key_override in the operator's config file, not per-user); model chosen at runtime (assistant config / --model) and the repo's default literal gpt-3.5-turbo is a catalog id. Caveats: the same expression also serves oai-compat: models against a user-configured third-party base_url, and the Azure subclass (azure_openai.py:9 AzureOpenAI client) reuses it; those paths should stay on their vendor (rule 2). Reasoning models send tools=[web_search_preview].

Rule 8: non-streaming responses.create with store=False; same client/endpoint/key/model reasoning as line 55 (default endpoint via env/config, catalog default gpt-3.5-turbo, runtime model). Same caveats for oai-compat: and the Azure subclass path.

Rule 6: client.messages.stream on anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or config anthropic_api_key), default endpoint, no betas (thinking is the GA param). Model chosen at runtime and none of the repo's Claude literals (code checks 'claude-3-7'/'claude-3'/'claude-2'/'instant'; README uses claude-3-opus-20240229, claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219) are Router catalog ids or dated equivalences.
Rule 6: client.messages.create (non-streaming), same client and runtime model as line 86; no Claude literal in the repo is in the catalog.
Rule 2: cohere.Client.chat_stream goes to Cohere's endpoint; the repo's Cohere model literals (command-r, command-r-plus) are not in Router's catalog, so rule 7 handoff does not apply.
Rule 2: cohere.Client.chat (non-streaming) to Cohere; no Cohere model in the catalog.

Rule 7: google.genai client.models.generate_content_stream (key GEMINI_API_KEY or config google_api_key); model chosen at runtime and one of the repo's Gemini literals, gemini-2.5-pro (pricing prefix), is a Router catalog id.
Rule 7: google.genai client.models.generate_content (non-streaming); same as line 60, gemini-2.5-pro is in the catalog.
